text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The deserted island project was progressing smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Tester Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, I found this big feather
near the training facilities...
What kind of bird do you think it's from?

text_block_list.name: Tester Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ho, ta, torya, orya, hochaaa!
Ah, I sent the rock flying!
It's gotten way too light!

text_block_list.name: Tester Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you try the maze yet?
It's bigger than before, so it was super satisfying!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Fufu, fufufu, fuhahaha...!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
They gather, they gather, they are gathering!
The fuel for our future is gathering!
With tremendous momentum!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
We'll keep brushing it up!
More and more, reaching even greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"No one can block the path to the strongest
training facility!!
Bwaaa-hahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Tucker's been
in a super good mood lately!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To think that so many testers gathered for us.
I'm so glad we all worked hard together!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Right! Everyone totally got swept up
by Tucker-san's enthusiasm, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, who even is
Mr. Tucker in the first place?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Her manner of speech keeps shifting between polite and rough,
giving off a mysterious vibe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, why is she so passionate about developing a deserted island—
building the ultimate training facility?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's true!
I have no idea why she started it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't seem to be with the URA, either.
...Just who is Mr. Tucker?

text_block_list.name: Tester Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
……? Even the project members don't know
Tucker Brine's true identity?

text_block_list.name: Tester Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that can happen.
...Could it be that you kept it a secret on purpose?
Just kidding~

text_block_list.name: Tester Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! Why make it a secret?

text_block_list.name: Tester Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Look, for example... what if they secretly hate
Tracen Academy and are building a rival facility
to steal away students! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Tester Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
There's no way that's true... right?
Though if it really were...
might be kind of funny, huh?
